newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- National People's Congress Chairman Qiao Shi visits Mongolia
- Qiao Shi visits Xinjiang, urges to fight against separatism
- State Council Hong Kong and Macau Affairs office gives details of right of abode in Hong Kong after handover

- Grain purchasing departments in northeastern Heilongjiang and Jilin provinces preserve vast quantities of purchased grain. Last year grain output in two provinces totalled 53.25 million tonnes, of which 34 million tonnes was purchased and shipped to other areas
- Construction work on Xiaolangdi water control project on Yellow River speeded up to guarantee damming of river as scheduled on October 31
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Northwestern Gansu province forms company to produce coloured cotton
CHINA SECURITIES
- Investment by individuals allowed and encouraged in reform of state firms, but private ownership ruled out, says Vice Minister of Economic Restructuring Commission Hong Hu
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Agricultural Bank outstanding loans 631.791 billion at end March
- Floating workers from Sichuan province sent back 20.2 billion yuan to their homes in 1996, equivalent to Sichuan province total financial revenue for the year
CHINA BUSINESS TIMES
- Fujian province sets target of 11 percent for GDP growth in 1997 compared with 14.8 percent in 1996
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China to move 870 million tonnes of grains from northeastern provinces and Inner Mongolia to south by end-June
MARKET DAILY
- Hebei province sets up large cashmere production base with total investment of 480 million yuan
- China State Shipbuilding Corp aims at 3.0 million tonnes and pre-tax profits of 3.0 billion yuan by year 2000
- Beijing Five Star Beer makes losses of 60 million yuan in 1995, cuts losses by 45 million yuan in 1996
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- China state purchase of grain reaches 118.5 million tonnes by end-March
CHINA DAILY
- China prepares to launch two domestically made satellites aboard Long March rockets soon
- China provides grain aid to North Korea
